d: FC Goa secured a 2-1 victory over Inter Kashi at the Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex in Pune. Francisco Feuillassier opened the scoring for FC Goa before Sumeet Passi brought Inter Kashi back on level terms early in the second half. Christian Borrego restored Goa’s lead in the 66th minute with the decisive goal. FC Goa held on to secure their first win of the season.
